name: opencamp-hq/cli
what_it_holds: MIT-licensed CLI that queries the recreation.gov API for real-time federal campground/campsite availability, with polling + email alerts. No stored historical data — live query tool only. 22 stars, updated 9 Jul 2026 (active).
why_useful: Federal campground/national-park booking is a leisure book-ahead demand pool adjacent to Airbnb's rural/nature-destination nights; a live availability-pull method could be repurposed to build a point-in-time camping-demand series as a leisure-travel cross-check, though it stores nothing itself today.

name: ships/ridb
what_it_holds: Generated Rust client for the Recreation Information Database (RIDB), the federal government's single API for recreational facilities, campsites, activities and events on federal land nationwide. Boilerplate client code + OpenAPI spec, no bundled data.
why_useful: RIDB is a free, government-run, machine-pullable dataset of federal recreation facility metadata and (via related endpoints) availability — a ready-made acquisition path for a national outdoor-leisure-demand time series, an unexplored proxy for the same discretionary-travel dollar Airbnb competes for.
time_coverage: live API, no history in repo
last_activity: 2024-04-18 (repo last commit; RIDB API itself is current)
